profile_text.body:
Manus AI is the company behind Manus, an autonomous AI agent it describes as "the action engine that goes beyond answers to execute tasks, automate workflows, and extend your human reach." The product is positioned not as a conversational tool but as an execution layer, taking actions on behalf of users rather than simply returning information.

The Manus product spans several capabilities listed on the company's site, including a browser operator, wide research, mail handling, a Slack integration, and generation tools for design, slides, images, and music. The site also references a web app and pricing, indicating a commercial offering. The held facts categorize Manus under Automation and Agents and note it as an autonomous agent with high decision influence.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
